sloka: ततः कुर्युः समाह्वानं राक्षस्यो रक्षसामपि ।राक्षसेन्द्रनियुक्तानां राक्षसेन्द्रनिवेशने ।। ५.३०.२६।।।।
transliteration: tataḥ kuryuḥ samāhvānaṁ rākṣasyo rakṣasāmapi ।rākṣasendraniyuktānāṁ rākṣasendraniveśane ।। 5.30.26।।।।

translations.english: "Thereafter the ogresses will draw the attention of demon guards engaged by the king of demons at his residence towards me.
